limitations: Depth is separate relative monocular estimation, not metric geometry validation.
Views remain predominantly front-facing with height and modest azimuth variation; no back/roof/exterior evidence.
Large dark regions and moving performer occlude furniture and wall boundaries.
City backdrop may be texture or geometry; not established.
Later independent replay same-scene validation pending.
Playback 0.5x used only for late navigation, no frame interpolation or upsampling applied.
